descriptions: Added custom locations for Store Shelves — shelves that are part of the map (not props) can now be searched too. In the editor go to Store Shelves → Locations, stand facing the shelf and press Add My Position (or paste coords like x, y, z / vector3(...)).
You can now set the size of the Store Shelves search spot. Changes apply as soon as you save, no restart needed. Works with ox_target, qb-target and standalone.
Mailboxes: the robbery animation now plays every time, not just on the first attempt.
Mailboxes: failing the lockpick now ends the attempt. Before, it trapped you in the 'stuck' minigame until you won it.
Mailboxes: getting stuck now only happens after a successful robbery (Stuck Chance), and you get at most 5 tries to break free.
Mailboxes: opening a letter can no longer give you another letter.

When updating: if you use your own edited target file (src/targets/*.lua), copy the new addSphereZone and removeZone functions into it or Store Shelves locations won't show. Everything else keeps working without them.
Restart the resource; your editor settings carry over.
